## About
Alsip Auto & Collision is a full service collision and auto body shop that also handles mechanical repairs and periodic maintenance. When you have questions about damage or repairs, we want to give you a straight, accurate answer.
Some of our customers first came here with their parents and still bring their own cars to us. Neighbors rate us 4.3 from 75 reviews on Google, and many of them mention the same thing: honest people doing careful work.
Beyond repairs, we sell high quality repairable vehicles and luxury rebuilt vehicles.

## Services
- Collision and body repair: Accident and body damage repair, from minor dents to cars that looked like a total loss.
- Mechanical repair and maintenance: Mechanical repairs and periodic maintenance to keep your vehicle running its best.
- Rebuilt and repairable vehicles: We sell repairable vehicles and luxury rebuilt vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: Can I have accident repairs done through my insurance?
A: Yes. Customers have brought their cars to us for accident repairs handled through their insurance.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on Cicero Avenue in Alsip, conveniently close to the expressway.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
